item.title: Ocala Coast Guardsman and family ID’d in fatal carbon monoxide poisoning
item.description: A member of the United States Coast Guard, his wife, and his two children have been identified by the Marion County Sheriff's Office as the individuals who were found dead last week in an Ocala home due to suspected carbon monoxide poisoning. Read more: Ocala Coast Guardsman and family ID’d in fatal carbon monoxide poisoning

item.title: Robert Russell Pratt
item.description: Robert Pratt loved the Lord, and his faith was evident in every aspect of his life. He will be remembered as a faithful servant of God, and a man whose life reflected unwavering faith, humility, and love. Read more: Robert Russell Pratt

item.title: Former Ocala high school dean gets 15 years for sex offenses against students
item.description: A former dean at Vanguard High School, who pleaded no contest to making sexual advances towards multiple students, has been sentenced to 15 years in prison. Read more: Former Ocala high school dean gets 15 years for sex offenses against students

item.title: Nita Lashawn Brannen
item.description: Nita Brannen was a woman of remarkable presence, known for her love of cooking. Her passion for fashion and jewelry was evident to all, as she navigated the world with impeccable style and nails that were always sharp and expressive. Read more: Nita Lashawn Brannen

item.title: Ocala Chinese restaurant fails inspection after live squirrel found in kitchen
item.description: A Chinese restaurant in southwest Ocala was temporarily closed after a health inspector cited the business for several code violations, including the presence of a live squirrel and rodent droppings. Read more: Ocala Chinese restaurant fails inspection after live squirrel found in kitchen

item.title: Lillian Elizabeth Blomlie

item.title: Ocala woman accuses dental office of botching implants
item.description: An Ocala woman has accused a local dental practice of botching an implant procedure that left her with permanent injuries that require corrective surgery. Read more: Ocala woman accuses dental office of botching implants

item.title: Police: Ocala man caught trying to steal car outside smoke shop
item.description: A 30-year-old Ocala man is facing a felony theft charge after he allegedly tried to drive away in another man’s vehicle that had been left running outside a local smoke shop. Read more: Police: Ocala man caught trying to steal car outside smoke shop

item.title: I remember a fantastic ice cream shop in Ocala in the 1970s
item.description: "In the early 1970s, there was a Breyers ice cream shop in downtown Ocala, on the Broadway side of the former Barnett Bank building. They had the dipping containers and it was the real, top-shelf, unpacked ice cream." - An Ocala resident shares his opinion. Read more: I remember a fantastic ice cream shop in Ocala in the 1970s
